fix: Re-capture the work images as full-page or section screenshots of the websites Sylvain designed and built: rafaeldecardenas.com, brunomoinardeditions.com, p-a-c.fr, ethicsfordesign.com, lowtechlab.org, grand-cuisine.fr, unknown-untitled.com, qalqalah.org.
